title: 第9章 给神兽放血第10章 冲天剑意
slug: 我修天道见谁都能一招秒
content_zh:
罗天盘膝坐在妖狼身上，以极快的速度朝天荡山中心飞掠而去。
“喂，那神兽，是什么样子的？”
罗天一手抓着狼毛，一边问道。
“他……是我们天荡山妖兽之王，本体是一头五色神牛，出生就是化灵境，如今更是通玄五重了。”
狼妖说道。
“通玄境的妖兽么？”
罗天微微点头。
“那个……前辈，不知道您找他，有什么事么？”
狼妖试探着问道。
“哦，没什么大事，有点事求他。”
罗天道。
妖狼听罢，长出了一口气。
“那就好，我得提醒前辈，妖王的实力很恐怖，脾气也极为暴躁！
而且他尤其不喜欢人类，您见了他，可要小心一些。”
妖狼说道。
罗天点点头道：“放心吧，我这人很和善的。”
和善？
狼妖心里都在骂娘了。
自己差点就被他一拳砸死了，就这样还还和善？
但是这些话，他可不敢对罗天说。

天荡山脉虽然大，但是狼妖熟悉路，速度又快。
不过半日光景，就来到了天荡山核心区域。
“前辈，前面就是妖王的领地了，您可一定要小心，不要激怒我们妖王，他一旦发起脾气来，后果可是很严重的！”
狼妖显然十分忌惮那五色神牛。
“知道了！”
罗天点点头说道。
又向前行了一段路，罗天发现四周的草木都繁盛了起来。
甚至不时能看到一些稀有的灵药仙果，自行吞吐灵气。
“这些，都是妖王收藏来的宝物，您看看就好，可千万不能擅自拾取！
曾经有一位通玄境的妖兽，盗取仙果树被妖王发现，被他老人家活生生劈死了！”
狼妖介绍道。
罗天一愣，惊讶道：“哦？同为通玄境，也能被劈死？”
狼妖点点头道：“那当然！
前辈不知道，神兽血脉这种东西，根本强得不讲道理！
同境界而论，神兽能打五个妖兽！
这还是妖王血统不纯，纯血五色神牛，实力更强！”
罗天听罢，不住点头。
就在这时……
“何人闯我领地？”
一个声音，瓮声瓮气的传来。

狼妖浑身一颤，立刻回应道：“妖王大人，是我……有一位人类前辈，想来拜会大人，有事相求。”
“人类？”
content_en:
Luo Tian sat cross-legged on the demon wolf and flew towards the center of Tiandang Mountain at an extremely fast speed.
"Hey, what does that mythical beast look like?"
Luo Tian asked while holding the wolf fur in one hand.
"He...is the king of our Tiandang Mountain monsters. He is a five-color sacred bull. He was born in the spirit transformation realm, and now he is in the fifth level of Tongxuan."
The wolf demon said.
"A monster from the Tongxuan Realm?"
Luo Tian nodded slightly.
"That...senior, I didn't know you were looking for him. What's the matter?"
The wolf demon asked tentatively.
"Oh, it's nothing serious. I have something to ask him for."
Luo Tiandao.
After hearing this, the demon wolf let out a sigh of relief.
"That's good, I have to remind senior that the Demon King is terrifyingly powerful and has an extremely bad temper!
And he especially doesn't like humans, so be careful when you meet him. "
The demon wolf said.
Luo Tian nodded and said, "Don't worry, I'm a very kind person."
Kind?
The wolf demon was cursing his mother in his heart.
He was almost punched to death by him, so he was still kind?
But he didn't dare to say these words to Luo Tian.
Although the Tiandang Mountains are large, the wolf demon knows the roads well and is fast.
In just half a day, we arrived at the core area of ​​Tiandang Mountain.
"Senior, the Demon King's territory is ahead. You must be careful not to anger our Demon King. Once he loses his temper, the consequences will be serious!"
The wolf demon is obviously very afraid of the five-color sacred cow.
"Got it!"
Luo Tian nodded and said.
After walking forward for a while, Luo Tian found that the vegetation around him was growing lush.
From time to time, you can even see some rare elixirs and fairy fruits, breathing in spiritual energy on their own.
"These are all treasures collected by the Demon King. Just take a look at them, but you must not pick them up without permission!
There once was a demon beast in the Tongxuan Realm who stole the fairy fruit tree and was discovered by the demon king. He was hacked to death by his old man! "
The wolf demon introduced.
Luo Tian was stunned and said in surprise: "Oh? We are both in the Tongxuan realm, and we can also be hacked to death?"
The wolf demon nodded and said: "Of course!
Seniors don’t know that things like the blood of divine beasts are so powerful that it’s unreasonable!
In terms of the same realm, the divine beast can defeat five monsters!
This is still a demon king with impure blood, a pure-blooded five-color sacred cow, even more powerful! "
After hearing this, Luo Tian couldn't help but nod.
Just then...
"Who intrudes into my territory?"
A voice came loudly.
The wolf demon shuddered and immediately responded: "Sir Demon King, it's me... there is a senior human who wants to pay a visit to you and ask for help."
"Human?"
